rationale: Although SNEX shows bearish continuation below both session VWAP ($36.92) and the 5m 9-EMA ($36.72) following a massive prior-day breakdown, current bid-ask spread is very wide at 49.4 bps ($0.18), representing nearly 40% of a 5m ATR in immediate execution friction. Furthermore, the portfolio is already 95% utilized with 80% of buying power committed short (including existing financial sector exposure in GS and SFNC) and only ~5% available buying power remaining. Taking a micro-sized position into heavy slippage while nearing maximum leverage and directional concentration offers poor expected value.
